description: memory_search/memory_context module functions on literal values: representation and text hashes, vector normalisation and float32 packing (ints, floats, mixed and big ints with CPython's sum(), overflow, zero, bools, strings, dicts, non-sized values), vector decoding, identity keys, entity keys, validity windows, bounds, memory entries, mandatory constraints, sections, sized packets and the complete-JSON budget (dropping optional entries, then edges, then gaps; blocking when mandatory content does not fit).
